style_name: Pompey freskasi ruhidagi kinematik moy bo'yoq (terrakota, oxra, kul kulrang, vulqon to'q sarig'i)
image_prefix: vertical 9:16, no text, no letters, no logos, semi-realistic cinematic oil painting, realistic natural human proportions and faces (not cartoon), Pompeian fresco palette: terracotta red, ochre, ash grey, glowing volcanic orange, dramatic light.
character_prefix: semi-realistic cinematic oil painting, Pompeian fresco palette, realistic proportions and face (not cartoon), single person only, half body, isolated on a plain flat pure white background, no shadow, no scenery, no text.
prop_prefix: semi-realistic cinematic oil painting, Pompeian fresco palette, single object only, bold clean shape, isolated on a plain flat pure white background, no shadow, no text.
